::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 5 [1899]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.[^1]
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)
Many thanks for being so kind as to send me [your book](other_books/otherbook_124.qmd). I am glad it has prospered enough to come to another edition-

I think that the notice of [Mr Wither](people/person_1544.qmd)’s birth was as it stood in the Hants’ paper  I suppose it came from the roll at Winchester though I certainly thought he would have been 90 in November -

I am glad your German expedition was fairly satisfactory

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ J F Moor/ Glencairn/ Chiselhurst. Postmarked Winchester My 5/99.
